provider: ISIMIP / Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research (PIK)
api_version: ISIMIP repository API v1 dataset-filelist metadata route, not the NetCDF product version

request_contract.parameter_rules: This contract documents exactly one ISIMIP metadata-filelist route and is not permission to run automated HTTP requests. Do not fetch NetCDF, crawl adjacent datasets, modify dataset UUID or file family, use query parameters, redirects or credentials. A future independently approved read-only metadata receipt must record the original exact URI, date, byte count, SHA256 and 72-file completeness. The provider also publishes exact version/rights/size/SHA-512 claims on the fixed dataset metadata URL; that second route is likewise nonexecutable.

response_contract.format: Expected provider text/plain annual URL list (ASCII); prior public research fetch observed 72 yearly ER11-wind maxrain file names from 1950 to 2021, but did not preserve an independently verified raw response checksum. Content-Type and original byte integrity remain unverified.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: One annual file may contain storm-event-derived maximum 24-hour TC rainfall; this is not observed wind intensity, not annual insured loss, not 72 independent simulated model years and not a second independent IBTrACS observation. Storm rain modelling also uses ERA5 and physical reconstruction; preserve event ID, parent cyclone lineage, grid, units and aggregation before NextGen integration.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: No automated probe/download currently authorised. Future provider access policy and dataset-specific commercial rights review must precede even bounded metadata probes under repository governance.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: ISIMIP catalogues and file availability may change independently of this fixed UUID. Filename presence is not a NetCDF content signature or checksum; exact model years and output semantics must be confirmed after approval.

rights_and_policy.notes: The exact ISIMIP publisher metadata for dataset edition 20240402 explicitly declares CC0 1.0 at dataset level and all 72 file entries. Separately, ISIMIP public terms forbid sale of the data and require compliance with assigned licences. These CC0 declarations are useful evidence but upstream IBTrACS/ERA5 terms, insurer-specific commercial application, scientific fitness, original-byte integrity and derivative/redistribution obligations have not been fully approved; do not automate or admit this product.

notes: T0 nonexecutable source-access record; exact route ties to the existing offline 72-year filelist checker. No data transfer, original NetCDF file headers, independent response SHA256, insurer asset records, official legal permission or model admission. Cross-cyclone peril components only link after verified common physical event IDs.
